title: Wire Under the Big Top
premise: A long circus drama under the red-and-white big top with flashing magnesium light. Annuan and Anchuan have faces easily confused; the aerial rings go intact→rope worn→rope replaced; the carriage 'Spark Star' must be avoided after it is wrecked; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.

states.prime_ringmaster: Ringmaster Pei Lie in his fifties, gray buzz cut, deep-red tailcoat and black vest, a gilt whistle pinned to his chest, hands covered in calluses and old scars.
states.injured_with_cane: The same Pei Lie injured: right leg in a splint, leaning on a black lacquer cane as he walks slowly, still wearing that faded deep-red tailcoat.
states.deceased: Pei Lie has closed his eyes and passed away, lying quietly on the narrow couch in the dressing room behind the tent, face peaceful, breath gone.

states.young_apprentice: Young Annuan: a fifteen-year-old lean aerial apprentice, coral-red hair ribbon, cream practice leotard, cyan ankle guard on her left ankle, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_lead: Adult Annuan: a supple aerial lead in her twenties, still with coral-red hair ribbon and cyan left ankle guard, expression steady.

states.intact_taut: A pair of aerial rings suspended from the big-top dome, chrome steel rings intact, hemp rope taut and gleaming, magnesium light making the rings snow-bright.
states.rope_worn: The same aerial rings with frayed worn hemp rope, rings tilted, tension slack so they sway.
states.rope_replaced: The aerial rings with new hemp rope restored to tautness, fresh rope knots on the rings, distinct from the original intact state.

states.intact: A hardcover show rehearsal book, circus emblem on the cover, pages marked in red pen with beats and blocking.
states.paint_stained: The same show rehearsal book stained when paint was knocked over, cover sticky, writing blurred into color patches.

states.intact: A vermilion circus carriage, doors spray-painted with gold letters 'Spark Star', triangular pennant on the roof, prop crates inside.
states.shaft_broken: The vermilion carriage with broken shaft overturned, pennant snapped, an un-tourable wreck.

states.young_cameo: Young Anchuan: face extremely similar to Annuan's, but indigo hair ribbon, silver bell ankle guard on right ankle, more playful expression.
states.adult_clown: Adult Anchuan: face extremely similar to adult Annuan's, still indigo ribbon and bell ankle guard, half the face painted white.

segments.action: At dusk, Pei Lie lifts the flap and enters the circus big top; the aerial rings hang taut and gleaming under dome magnesium light.
A row of five magnesium floodlights hangs from the big-top steel beams; Pei Lie polishes each lamp shade one by one.
Two opening gongs hang at the tent entrance; Pei Lie reaches up and lets the gong faces tremble softly.
Pei Lie walks the shadow of the aerial rings, checking hemp-rope tension and safety clasps.
Pei Lie gazes out the tent door at the sky over the practice yard.
The intact aerial rings hang quietly from the circus big-top dome.
Pei Lie sits at the sand's edge and dozes in the magnesium light.
Night wind pours through the tent door; Pei Lie pulls his tailcoat collar tight.
Pei Lie opens the show rehearsal book and marks the evening's beats in red pen.
Pei Lie draws a blocking arc on the show rehearsal book.
Pei Lie closes the show rehearsal book and puts it in the director's desk drawer.
Magnesium light from the aerial rings sweeps across Pei Lie's profile.
Pei Lie wipes fingerprints from the gilt whistle with a soft cloth.
At dawn in the outdoor practice yard, Pei Lie welcomes young Annuan arriving on the vermilion Spark Star.
Annuan hops down from Spark Star and reties her coral-red hair ribbon.
Pei Lie points at the three balance balls by the mats and teaches Annuan to read center of gravity and landing points.
Annuan crouches on the old mat, curiously tracing the wear marks on the high-low bar.
Pei Lie points at the circus big-top dome and explains the aerial rings opening to Annuan.
Annuan looks back at Spark Star parked nearby, eyes full of longing.
The two stand shoulder to shoulder by the portable high-low bar, listening to the canvas snap in the wind.
In the props alley, indigo-ribboned Anchuan glances back from behind the fake flowers.

segments.action: Seasons turn; day after day Pei Lie lifts the flap and enters the circus big top.
On another snow night, Pei Lie wraps his tailcoat tight under the aerial rings.
Spring tour opens; Pei Lie calibrates the safety net at center sand.
Midsummer noon, Pei Lie wipes the sun-scorched iron stakes outside the tent.
Autumn rains linger; the aerial rings hemp rope turns stiff in the damp.
On another New Year's Eve, Pei Lie keeps the circus big top alone until dawn.
On the extra-show eve, Pei Lie checks safety clasps two hours early.
On a full-moon night, Pei Lie test-lights every magnesium floodlight.
Three showless nights in a row, Pei Lie revises the blocking chart again and again.
One windy night, Pei Lie has to tie down the tent ropes extra tight.
Rope creaks; Pei Lie looks up quickly to check the aerial rings.
At three in the morning, Pei Lie sips cold tea from a thermos.
He sorts balance ball numbers at the director's desk.
Opening gongs tremble softly in the wind; Pei Lie lifts his head to listen.
As the horizon pales, Pei Lie notes the last beat group of the night.
Before lowering the canvas, he takes one last look at the intact hemp rope on the aerial rings.
At daybreak, Pei Lie patrols the outdoor practice yard; vermilion Spark Star is parked by the high-low bar.
Pei Lie crouches to inspect Spark Star's shaft and pennant.
Pei Lie walks to the mat edge; the same three balance balls still stand in neat order.
An unfamiliar ochre props truck drives along the camp road, mats in the bed, not Spark Star.
Pei Lie stands on the packed-earth yard, recording last night's peak wind speed.
Pei Lie realigns the edges of the old mats.
Morning mist recedes in the distance, revealing deeper riverbank shadows.
A storm bursts; the circus big top billows in gale wind; the aerial rings swing violently.
Magnesium light flickers wildly; Pei Lie rushes to the emergency winch.
A dull crack—the aerial rings hemp rope frays and wears, rings tilting and swaying.

segments.action: A silver-gray Luminous Stream parade cart rolls onto the outdoor practice yard, nothing like the broken-shaft Spark Star.
Supervisor Chao walks onto the practice yard and talks beside Pei Lie; the two builds are much alike.
Supervisor Chao points at the Luminous Stream parade cart and explains the new touring schedule to Pei Lie.
The Luminous Stream parade cart drives away; Pei Lie stays alone on the practice yard watching it go.
Wind flaps the schedule sheet Supervisor Chao left behind.
Outside camp arrives Tangtang the acrobatics school girl with a coral-red ribbon; at a glance she somewhat resembles young Annuan.
Tangtang the acrobatics school girl tries a stretch; Pei Lie shakes his head—she is not Annuan after all.
Tangtang the acrobatics school girl carries her practice shoes away from the outdoor practice yard, back fading down the camp road.
Years later at dusk, Pei Lie with a splinted right leg stands at the circus big-top entrance leaning on a black lacquer cane.
